fields.title: Building Scalable Django Backends
fields.summary: Best architectural practices for structuring Django REST APIs with MySQL/PostgreSQL databases.
fields.content: Designing high-concurrency backends requires careful database indexing, granular permission sets, and clean serializations with Django REST Framework.

fields.content: A detailed technical breakdown of state management, custom responsive layout grids, and JWT token refresh middleware.
